exposure: type of spinal anesthetic technique (SIS or CSE)
cohort: Patients who underwent unscheduled intrapartum cesarean delivery requiring single injection spinal (SIS) or combined spinal-epidural (CSE) anesthesia after removal of an indwelling labor epidural catheter between January 1, 2020, and December 31, 2022.
finding: The spinal bupivacaine dose generally increased with increasing patient height and decreased with increasing patient weight, suggesting these factors can be used for dose determination.
